test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: In MS-Excel 2019, what does the SUM function do?

options.text: It multiplies the values in a range.
It adds up the values in a range.
It counts the number of cells in a range.
It finds the average of values in a range.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It adds up the values in a range**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The SUM function adds values.
 
• You can add individual values, cell references or ranges or a mix of all three.
 
• For example: =SUM(A2:A10) - Adds the values in cells A2:10.
